answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 23689 Country: Bangladesh Title: Using laud-speaker in salat is it permissible according to shariah? is it against sunnah? please clarify me in which stage do we able to use laud-speaker & which stage not? Question: Using laud-speaker in salat is it permissible according to shariah? is it against sunnah? please clarify me in which stage do we able to use laud-speaker & which stage not? Answer ID: 23689 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1380/1020/H=1431) It is lawful if the voice of Imam reaches to only all the muqtadis easily and the loudspeaker system works well that does not disturb khusu (dedication) in salah. If the voice crosses the necessary limit or any other evil creeps in, then it is makrooh and against sunnah to use it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
